title: A Parish for the Verdict
author: Odile Ishikawa
blurb: Yara Halloran, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
